text:
As a direct and proximate result of this collision, John Smith sustained significant injuries including:

• Initial emergency room visit and examination (emergency medical care, severity: moderate)

• MRI examination for diagnostic purposes (diagnostic imaging, severity: moderate)

• Physical therapy and rehabilitation treatment (physical therapy sessions, severity: moderate)

John Smith was treated by Dr. Michael Jones with total expenses of $8,950. He underwent an initial emergency room visit and examination due to the moderate severity of his injuries. Further diagnostic assessments were carried out using an MRI examination. To aid in his recovery, physical therapy and rehabilitation treatments have been necessary.
